title: Act: Implement the Markdown contribution store and path sanitizer
summary: Each contribution becomes a distinct Markdown file; traversal is rejected.
description: Context: the service needs a Store. Desired behavior: Store writes worlds/<world>/rounds/<round>/contributions/<id>.md with a generated ID under a mutex, refuses overwrite, commits via the Git interface, and rejects unsafe path segments. Expected result: concurrent submissions never collide. Why: immutability and safety.
acceptance_criteria: Given two concurrent Save calls, when both complete, then two different files exist and each contains its own prompt
Given an existing file for an ID, when Save would write it again, then the write fails and the file is unchanged
Given a worldID or roundID containing .., a slash or a backslash, when Save runs, then safepath.ErrUnsafe is returned and nothing is written

in_scope: Each contribution becomes a distinct Markdown file; traversal is rejected.
preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Product code compiles with go build ./...

steps.action: Create package safepath with ErrUnsafe and Segment(s string) error that accepts only ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ and returns ErrUnsafe otherwise.
steps.expected: Segment(".."), "a/b" and "" return ErrUnsafe; "ROUND-0000001" returns nil

steps.action: Define Contribution{ID, WorldID, RoundID, PlayerID, Prompt string; CreatedAt time.Time}; NewID returns "CON-"+32 hex chars from crypto/rand; render produces YAML front matter (id, world, round, player, created_at RFC3339) then a blank line and the prompt; parse reverses it.
steps.expected: render then parse yields an equal Contribution

steps.symbol: new: FileStore, Save, Get, ListByPlayer, CountByPlayer, HasPrompt
steps.action: Create FileStore{Root string; Git gitrepo.Committer; mu sync.Mutex} implementing Store. Save validates WorldID and RoundID with safepath.Segment, assigns NewID when ID is empty, locks mu, creates dir worlds/<world>/rounds/<lower-case round>/contributions, opens <id>.md with os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY (0o644), writes render output, then calls Git.Commit(ctx, []string{relPath}, "contribution <id>"). Get(id) validates id then walks worlds/*/rounds/*/contributions for <id>.md; ListByPlayer, CountByPlayer and HasPrompt read matching files.
steps.expected: Files are created exclusively and committed through the interface
